title: Claude Agent SDK (TypeScript)
summary: query() with in-process MCP tools (zod schemas), canUseTool as the approval gate, no built-in tools, turn and budget limits, OpenTelemetry spans.
verified: RUN: type-checked with tsc 7.0.2 against @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.329 and OpenTelemetry JS (api 1.10, sdk-trace 3.1), and tests plus gold set ran here against the offline stub (same tools, same permission callback). The live query() path is type-checked only: no live model call was made here.
stack_line: A Claude Agent SDK agent in TypeScript (@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3).
run_cmd: npm start -- "Where is my order ORD-1001?"
setup_steps:
- uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
live: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or the Bedrock variables) and AGENT_MODE=live.
next: Replace the tool bodies in src/tools.ts with calls to your systems.
Route the approval in makeGate() to a real person instead of the approve argument.
Rewrite evals/gold.jsonl for your use case; keep the safety and gate tags.

ai_act.purpose: Answers customers' questions about their orders and requests refunds; a person approves every refund before it is issued.
notice: You're chatting with an AI assistant, not a person.

open_line: Anthropic is this stack's model by choice, recorded in `.qz/practices.json`; for an open-weight model, start from the LangGraph or OpenAI Agents SDK starter.

api.none: a command-line agent today; the 1.1 solution composer serves it over HTTP with approvals in the API

knowledge.none: answers from its tools (the order lookup), not from documents; a RAG kit joins as a tool when it needs them
